newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to set CVRD base price on Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to set CVRD base price on Feb 5.

text.p: BRASILIA, Jan 31 (reuter) - Brazil will set a base price for the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) on Feb 5, a spokeswoman for the Planning Ministry said.
The spokeswoman said the National Privatization Council is to meet Feb 5, a day earlier than originally scheduled, to establish the minimum price.
The meeting had been set for Feb 6 after being delayed from late January, while the government awaited a report on new copper and gold finds in northern Brazil's Carajas' region.
